title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON THE AGGRAVATED PUNISHMENT OF SPECIFIC CRIMES
title_original: 특정범죄 가중처벌 등에 관한 법률 시행령
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe the scope of agencies or organizations and their officers to which the provisions concerning the crime of bribery provided for in Article 4 of the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes shall apply.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on No. 23363, Dec. 13, 2011]

Article 2 (Scope of Government-managed Enterprises) The agencies or organizations provided for in Article 4 (1) of the Act on the Aggravated Punishment of Specific Crimes (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall be as follows: <Amended on Jan. 25, 2012; Jul. 24, 2015; May 31, 2016; Aug. 31, 2016; Jan. 15, 2019; Apr. 2, 2019; Sep. 10, 2020; Dec. 8, 2020; Aug. 31, 2021>
  1. Bank of Korea;
  2. Korea Development Bank;
  3. Industrial Bank of Korea;
  4. Korea Minting and Security Printing Corporation;
  5. Export-Import Bank of Korea;
  6. Credit Guarantee Fund;
  7. Korea Technology Finance Corporation;
  8. Financial Supervisory Service;
  9. Korea Exchange;
  10. Korea Consumer Agency;
  11. Korea International Cooperation Agency;
  12. Korea Fire Industry Technology Institute;
  13. Korea National Park Service;
  14. Korea Racing Authority;
  15. Korea Agro-Fisheries and Food Trade Corporation;
  16. Korea Rural Community Corporation;
  17. Korea Electric Power Corporation;
  18. Korea Coal Corporation;
  19. Korea Trade-Investment Promotion Agency;
  20. Korea Mine Rehabilitation and Mineral Resources Corporation;
  21. Korea Electrical Safety Corporation;
  22. Korea District Heating Corporation;
  23. Korea Gas Corporation;
  24. Korea Gas Safety Corporation;
  25. Energy Management Corporation;
  26. Korea SMEs and Startups Agency;
  27. Korea National Oil Corporation;
  28. Korea Radio Promotion Agency;
  29. Korea Environment Corporation;
  30. National Health Insurance Corporation;
  31. Labor Welfare Corporation;
  32. Human Resources Development Service of Korea;
  33. Korea Land and Housing Corporation;
  34. Korea Water Resources Corporation;
  35. Korea Expressway Corporation;
  36. Korea Tourism Organization;
  37. The Korea Real Estate Board established under the Korea Real Estate Board Act;
  38. Incheon International Airport Corporation;
  39. Korea Airports Corporation;
  40. Korea National Railway;
  41. Korea Broadcasting System;
  42. National Agricultural Cooperative Federation and its affiliated cooperatives;
  43. National Federation of Fisheries Cooperatives and its affiliated cooperatives;
  44. National Forestry Cooperatives Federation and its affiliated cooperatives;
  45. Port Authority established under the Port Authority Act;
  46. Korea Railroad Corporation established under the Korea Railroad Corporation Act.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on No. 23363, Dec. 13, 2011]

Article 3 (Scope of Officers) The officers of agencies or organizations under Article 4 (2) of the Act shall be as follows; provided, if they have status as public officials or quasi-public officials under other statutes, they shall not be excluded from the application of such statutes:
  1. Executive officers and officers not lower than vice-section chief (or section chief in cases of agencies or organizations without vice-section chief position in its employees hierarchy system) of agencies or organizations provided for in subparagraphs 1 through 40, 45, and 46 of Article 2, the National Agricultural Cooperatives Federation, the National Federation of Fisheries Cooperatives, and the National Forestry Cooperatives Federation;
  2. Executive officers of the Korea Broadcasting System, local agricultural cooperatives, local livestock cooperatives, cooperatives for various items and types of business and the federation of cooperatives by item (referring to those established under the Agricultural Cooperatives Act), district fisheries cooperatives, fisheries cooperatives for each type of business, the fisheries cooperatives for fisheries products processing, local forestry cooperatives, and forestry cooperatives for various items and types of business.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on No. 23363, Dec. 13, 2011]
